Phase 2 — Build Core Learning Modules Continue from the existing project. Do NOT regenerate existing components. Reuse the current design system. Build AI Study Coach Create a premium learning assistant interface. This is NOT ChatGPT. The interface should focus on structured learning. Include: Chat Area Suggested Questions Quick Action Buttons Response Mode Selector Modes: Learn Revision Prelims Mains Interview Each mock AI response should be presented as: Topic Explanation Key Points UPSC Relevance PYQ References (mock) Related Topics Generate Notes Button Generate Quiz Button Create a collapsible right-side panel showing: Sources Related Topics Generated Notes • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • 1
